description.zh: 基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份时，配置需备份账号的RAM角色名。
description.en: The name of the RAM role of the account to back up. This parameter is required when you configure cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role.

description.zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
- **CROSS_ACCOUNT**：基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份
- **CROSS_ACCOUNT_BY_RD**：基于资源目录配置跨账号备份
description.en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT**: Cross-account backup is configured by assuming a RAM role.

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT\_BY\_RD**: Cross-account backup is configured based on a resource directory.
The UID of the account to back up.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr delete-cross-account --cross-account-user-id 18413649795 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr DeleteCrossAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CrossAccountUserId 18413649795 --CrossAccountRoleName hbrcrossrole --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT
